title: Rosethorn
description: Rosethorn pack by DrJankovich. Better Purpur Bricks, Custom Totems, And more Jankiness!
body:
This resource pack is what I use for my 11 year Minecraft World, Rosethorn. Most things in this pack were designed as tweaks to use ontop of Drathmorgh's pack, Nebula.

If you play on my community server, Rosebuds, you will want to install this! I will be adding features to compliment our server.

# Features
- Rename totems for custom textures
- Purpur Blocks resemble the shape of Stone Bricks
- Observers that look like GlitchIntendedGaming
